rules.win_pct: Win % = (Wins + ½ × Ties) ÷ (Matches played − No results). No-result matches are left out of the denominator.
rules.ties: Players on the same value share a rank (1, 2, 2, 4) and are listed alphabetically. If players tie for a match's top contribution, they are all that match's MVP.
rules.contribution: Contribution points follow the Tabuk Spartans team scoring system shown below. They are a team model, not an official cricket statistic.
rules.counted: Only matches marked Provisional or Verified are counted. Provisional matches are shown as 'Pending verification'.
